notes: The two *his* of *his father* and *his mother* answer to no suffix in the Hebrew and are added under rule 18's closing sentence.
בְּנֵי־נָשֶׁר is rendered attributively as *the young eagles*, so rule 28 governs and no *of* is placed; both margins (*Or, the brook*, *Or, vultures*) were read and set aside under rule 38.
